get_context: get the global Context object containing KV cache and sequence metadata
set_context_prefill: set the global Context for prefill phase with cu_seqlens_q, cu_seqlens_k, and max sequence lengths
set_context_decode: set the global Context for decode phase with slot_mapping, context_lens, and block_tables
reset_context: reset the global Context to default values with all fields cleared
check_is_prefill: check the is_prefill flag on the global Context to determine inference phase
